subject.title: feat(diagnostics-otel): add vendor-neutral session attribute option for OTel session grouping

question: Should telemetry grouping represent each reset-bounded OpenClaw session via sessionId, or intentionally represent the longer-lived routing bucket via sessionKey, and which attribute names are approved?
rationale: Both choices are technically possible but create materially different reset, retention, correlation, and privacy contracts that cannot be selected safely from implementation details alone.

options.title: Use reset-bounded sessionId
options.body: Hash or otherwise pseudonymize sessionId so /new, daily reset, and idle expiry start a distinct telemetry grouping, then emit only the approved compatibility attributes.

options.title: Approve stable routing grouping
options.body: Keep sessionKey-derived grouping only with explicit cross-reset tracking approval, stronger pseudonymization guidance, and documentation that it identifies a conversation bucket rather than a session.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Defer the config and attributes until OpenClaw has a canonical telemetry identity and retention policy.

recommendation.title: Use reset-bounded sessionId
recommendation.body: Hash or otherwise pseudonymize sessionId so /new, daily reset, and idle expiry start a distinct telemetry grouping, then emit only the approved compatibility attributes.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest recent merged history on the diagnostics and observability behavior affected by the choice.
